title: Well worth it.
text: Well worth it.. They werent kidding about being dusty lol..I rinsed them a few times but not enough..so I added a bit of dish soap to the hot water and let them sit over night. Dust is gone. There are some really nice pieces in here. One had a quartz strip on top..one has a rusty look to one side..others have white banding ..these are going to be fun to put in my fairy garden and in some of my larger plant pots for decoration..over the white sand I use.. Will make a nice contrast. Some pieces are about 1 inch in size, and about 4 are close to 4 inches. There is a big size variety.
